subject: Private deployment architecture readiness & timezone negotiation
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@clearglass.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 90m architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gap)

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for taking this on. We are planning a private deployment evaluation and would like a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive covering the following: VPC peering patterns, on-prem appliance topology, air-gapped update/install procedures, and key management/HSM integration.

Attendees will include myself, Raj (platform lead), and our security mailbox (security@clearglass.io). We’re based in PST (San Francisco) and prefer mornings here.

Can you propose two slots next week (ideally Tue/Wed morning PST)? If you have a short pre-kickoff checklist or prework, please attach. We’ll share an internal attendee list once the time is confirmed.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, ClearGlass Health
[attachment: corporate-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (referenced)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearglass.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90m architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gap)

Samira —

Appreciate the clear scope. We can do a 75-minute session that breaks into two blocks: 45 minutes architecture walkthrough + 30 minutes ops/security breakout/QA. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 2027-06-01 09:00–10:15
- Wed 2027-06-02 10:00–11:15

If neither works, share two alternatives and we’ll flex. I attached a lightweight pre-kickoff checklist to help your team collect network/topology details ahead of time.

Pre-kickoff highlights: expected outbound IPs, KMS/HSM vendor, airgap update cadence, and whether you plan multi-AZ on-prem racks. Can your security mailbox confirm if they’ll need an encrypted transit diagram or any SOC2 evidence in advance?

Attaching: pre-kickoff-checklist.pdf

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[attachment: pre-kickoff-checklist.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@clearglass.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@clearglass.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, security@clearglass.io
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90m architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gap)

Thanks Mateo — good options. Quick note on attendees and constraints:

- We have a small ops team in IST (India) that can only join late evening PST; our security lead can join on Wed but not Tue.
- For the session, we’ll want a short segment specifically on HSM (our vendor: KeyShield) and whether Redwood can integrate with customer-managed HSMs.

Wed 2027-06-02 10:00–11:15 PST works best for our security lead, but our lead sysadmin (in IST) can only do 19:30–20:30 PST. Could we consider the following approach: run the 75-minute session on Wed 10:00–11:15 PST and record the HSM/ops breakout for the IST folks as a 30-minute follow-up (live or recorded)?

Also, Samira asked whether you need our rack/network diagrams ahead of time. We can drop them in the Drive link if that helps.

On Thu, 27 May 2027 at 15:12, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> (reply inline)
>
> Hi Raj — Wed 10:00–11:15 PST should work. We can schedule a 30-minute follow-up focused on HSM/ops for the IST team; Vanessa, Diego — are you both OK recording or running a secondary live session in the evening PST?

Best,
Raj
Platform Lead, ClearGlass Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@clearglass.io>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@clearglass.io>, security@clearglass.io
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90m architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gap)

Looping in with logistics and a small schedule tweak request.

Vanessa and I can do Wed 2027-06-02 10:00–11:15 PST for the main walkthrough. For the HSM deep-dive for KeyShield, we should schedule a separate 30-minute slot the same day at 19:30 PST to accommodate IST — I can lead that one. Vanessa, I’ll record both sessions and drop the recordings and the slide deck in the Drive folder after.

Practical asks for Wed session (please upload if possible before Tue EOD):
- Network/rack diagram (PDF)
- KMS/HSM vendor name and admin contact
- List of expected external IP ranges and any proxy/inspection appliances that might break gRPC streaming

I’ll send the calendar invites once Samira confirms Wed 10:00–11:15 PST for the main session and approves the 19:30 PST ops breakout recording slot.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
